what_this_lane_delivers.capability: The Smart Form bet slip can hold more than one leg: legs are added, removed and reordered, and the slip renders a review of every leg before submission.
what_this_lane_delivers.what_it_deliberately_does_not_do: It does not submit a multi-leg ticket. There is no combined price, no parlay identity and no ticket-level persistence in this lane. A slip holding more than one leg cannot reach the submission endpoint at all — the submit control refuses it — so no multi-leg row can be written by this change.
what_this_lane_delivers.why_that_split: Parlay pricing, ticket identity, idempotency and grading are API and persistence work owned by the apps/api lane. Shipping the slip first gives that lane a real surface to bind to, and shipping it refusing to submit is what keeps the two halves from being half-wired in production.

unit_tests.label: The whole Smart Form package suite at the execution anchor, including apps/smart-form/test/bet-slip.test.ts (18 tests) added by this lane: adding a leg appends it, removing a leg leaves the rest in order, moveLeg reorders within bounds and refuses to wrap at either end, a leg missing a required field is refused with the list returned unchanged, and a slip of more than one leg is not submittable.
The new suite in isolation, so its result is not carried by the rest of the package.
